entries.title: Psalms 129:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents.>> "Many a time they have afflicted me from my youth," Let Israel now say-

entries.title: Psalms 129:2
segments: "Many a time they have afflicted me from my youth; Yet they have not prevailed against me.

entries.title: Psalms 129:3
segments: The plowers plowed on my back; They made their furrows long."

entries.title: Psalms 129:4
segments: The LORD [is] righteous; He has cut in pieces the cords of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 129:5
segments: ¶Let all those who hate Zion Be put to shame and turned back.

entries.title: Psalms 129:6
segments: Let them be as the grass [on] the housetops, Which withers before it grows up,

entries.title: Psalms 129:7
segments: With which the reaper does not fill his hand, Nor he who binds sheaves, his arms.

entries.title: Psalms 129:8
segments: Neither let those who pass by them say, "The blessing of the LORD [be] upon you; We bless you in the name of the LORD!"
